subject: Add missing moduleapi getchannels test and fix tests (#1002)
reason: The change modifies only test infrastructure: it registers the existing getchannels moduleapi test in the runtest-moduleapi runner script and updates the expected ACL DRYRUN error-message strings in tests/unit/moduleapi/getchannels.tcl to match the server's current message format ('User <name> has no permissions...'). No source file under src/ is touched, so no server behaviour, command reply, replication, or persistence path changes; there is nothing for a fuzzer scenario to exercise.
